summary: AngloGold Ashanti filed a 6-K announcing a general meeting of shareholders to approve a proposed $2.0bn share repurchase programme. The board approved the buyback on 7 May 2026, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals. The meeting will be held 23 July 2026 with a record date of 26 June 2026. The programme is discretionary; the company is not obligated to repurchase any specific number of shares and may suspend or discontinue at any time. This is a capital return event—share buybacks return cash to shareholders. Watch shareholder approval vote and market conditions for execution timing.
